GUARDIAN().notice: Emergency guardian — MUST be a contract (enforced in constructor) [H-3]

MAX_FEE_BPS().notice: Maximum protocol fee in basis points (200 = 2%)

MIN_QUANTITY().notice: Minimum order quantity (in base token units)

PRICE_SCALE().notice: Price denominated as (tokenOut per tokenIn) × PRICE_SCALE

createNote(bytes32,bytes32,address,addre.notice: Create a new private order note with ZK proof of solvency.

currentRootOf(address).notice: Returns the effective deposit root for a user (fallback to EMPTY_TREE_ROOT)

deposit(address,uint256,bytes32,uint256[.notice: Deposit ERC-20 tokens. Caller must supply a ZK DepositTransition         proof proving (oldRoot, DEPOSIT, token, actualReceived) → newRoot.

deposits(address,address).notice: user → token → deposited amount (total including locked)

globalDeposits(address).notice: token → total deposits across all users (global invariant tracker) [C-3]

isPaused().notice: Returns whether the pause is currently active (including expiry check)

lockedBalances(address,address).notice: user → token → amount reserved by active notes

noteInState(bytes32,uint8).notice: Returns true if a note commitment exists and is in the given state

pauseExpiresAt().notice: Block at which the current pause expires [H-3]

userDepositRoots(address).notice: user → current SMT deposit root (updated via ZK-verified transitions)
